verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no data-export or account-portability feature, such as a bulk export or a download of all agents, calls and recordings in open formats. The adjacent items do not count as an export capability: API access to transcripts, call-history raw execution data, a CLI and MCP server, and an open-source self-hostable framework are developer building blocks or different features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
